title: Add HTML report generator to multistep service
description: Brownfield Python task: add a generate_report function that reads from the store and writes a static HTML table report to a file.

task_spec.prompt:
Create a new file src/report.py. All 6 existing tests must still pass.

  def generate_report(output_path: str) -> str
    — reads all keys from the store using all_keys() and load(key)
    — generates an HTML page with a <table> listing each key and its values
      (one row per value: key column | value column)
    — writes the HTML to output_path
    — returns output_path

Import from src.store (all_keys, load).
All 6 existing tests must still pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: generate_report reads all keys and values from store
HTML output contains a <table> with key and value columns
Function writes HTML to output_path and returns it
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
